bug_description.original: Heap-use-after-free READ {*} in read_chunks_after_idat / spng_decode_image / spng_read_fuzzer.cc
bug_description.normalized: In read_chunks_after_idat(), a local pointer `data` caches ctx->data before calling read_chunk_bytes(). When the context is in streaming mode and the chunk length exceeds the current buffer size, read_data() reallocs ctx->data which frees the old buffer. The stale `data` pointer is then used in a memcpy to read chunk contents, resulting in a heap-use-after-free read.

tainted_value_origin.description: Chunk length parsed from the attacker-controlled PNG stream determines the size argument to read_chunk_bytes, triggering the realloc that invalidates the stale pointer.

source.description: Local pointer captures the current ctx->data buffer address before reading chunk body; this pointer becomes stale after the subsequent realloc.
source.value_from: ctx->data heap buffer allocated by spng_set_png_stream

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

root_cause.description: realloc frees the old ctx->data buffer when chunk.length > ctx->data_size in streaming mode; the caller's stale local `data` pointer is never refreshed.

sink.description: memcpy reads chunk.length (8289) bytes from the stale `data` pointer into exif.data, accessing freed heap memory.

fine_trace.note: Parses attacker-controlled 4-byte big-endian length from the PNG stream for the post-IDAT ancillary chunk. Value is 8289, exceeding SPNG_READ_SIZE (8192).
Local pointer captures the current ctx->data heap address (the 8192-byte buffer allocated by spng_set_png_stream). This will become stale after realloc.
read_data is entered via read_chunk_bytes with bytes=8289 (chunk.length). Condition is true because ctx->streaming==1 and 8289 > ctx->data_size (8192), so the reallocation branch executes.

realloc(ctx->data, 8289) frees the original 8192-byte heap buffer and returns a new allocation. ctx->data is updated to buf (line 294), but the local `data` in read_chunks_after_idat still holds the old freed address.
The chunk is ancillary (eXIf, type[0] bit 5 is set), so is_critical_chunk returns 0. Execution falls through to ancillary chunk type dispatch.
Chunk type matches eXIf; the exif handler is entered and will dereference the stale `data` pointer.
memcpy reads 8289 bytes from the stale `data` pointer that addresses a freed 8192-byte heap region. ASAN reports heap-use-after-free READ of size 8289.

parser_admitted.description: PNG signature and IHDR are validated; IDAT chunks are decoded by spng_decode_image before control reaches read_chunks_after_idat.

patch_analysis.patch_description: The fix moves `data = ctx->data` to after the read_chunk_bytes() call so that `data` always reflects the current (possibly reallocated) buffer. Critical chunk handling (IDAT/IEND) is moved before read_chunk_bytes to avoid unnecessary full reads. The CRC discard return value is negated to avoid confusion with successful returns.

key_changes.change: Moved `data = ctx->data` assignment from before read_chunk_bytes to after it, ensuring data always points to the current valid buffer.
Changed return from SPNG_CRC_DISCARD (positive 1) to -SPNG_CRC_DISCARD to avoid conflation with generic error codes.

format.name: PNG binary with oversized post-IDAT eXIf chunk
format.contract: A PNG file processed in streaming mode containing a post-IDAT eXIf ancillary chunk whose declared length (8289) exceeds SPNG_READ_SIZE (8192), causing read_data to realloc ctx->data while a stale local pointer is still held by the caller.
